Record row count, distinct IDs, parser rejects, row values and exit/logs; also test ordinary CRLF/LF controls and the separate trailing-LF symptom.
proposed_unexecuted.expected_behavior_basis: The upstream test source and PR report 60 rows on both paths after the fix and 61 parallel rows before it. The v1.5.6 source lacks the exact guard; actual v1.5.6 runtime outcome remains unknown until run.
proposed_unexecuted.success_criterion: Release decision based on observed behavior and exact build identity; block CRCRLF support until no duplicates, value corruption or silent record loss is demonstrated across boundary cases.
proposed_unexecuted.scope_limit: A small fixture does not establish safety for all CSV dialects, platforms, file sizes or arbitrary malformed data.
